consent_dm:
This chat is how you opt in.

If you reply Yes, I store your non-disappearing group messages in an encrypted database on the operator's server, and I send that text to OpenRouter Zero Data Retention providers when someone asks for a summary, follow-up, or @mentions me with a question. Summaries and answers are posted in the group, so everyone can read them — including people who never opted in.

I never keep disappearing messages. Mention me later and say opt out to delete your stored messages.

Reply Yes or No in this chat. Just that word (Y and N work too).
If you say No, you can still DM Yes later if you change your mind.
consent_clarify:
I only count Yes or No in this chat — the whole message, like Yes or No.
Yes = opt in. No = don't collect my messages.
Already said No? Send Yes anytime to opt in.
opted_in:
You're opted in.

In the group, mention me with Signal's mention picker (typing my name is not enough) and say:
• summarize the past N messages
• status
• dashboard — I'll DM a one-time link
• opt out
• anything else — I'll try to answer (I use recent chat when it's relevant)

Quote-reply a summary or any message in that thread to ask a follow-up. No mention needed for that.
declined:
Okay — I will not collect your messages.
Changed your mind later? Open this chat and send Yes. That's it.
opted_out:
You're opted out. I deleted your stored messages.
Want back in? DM me Yes.
unopted_group_notice: You're not opted in — I can't run commands for you in this group. Check your DM with me and reply Yes or No. Until then I'll ignore mentions like this.

Check your DM with me and reply Yes or No first.
Still waiting on opt-in. Send Yes in the DM when you're ready.

help_text:
Mention me in the group with Signal's mention picker (not just typing my name) and say:
• summarize the past N messages
• status — how many of your messages I have
• dashboard — I DM a one-time login link (15 minutes, works once)
• opt out — deletes your stored messages; DM Yes later to come back
• help — this list
• or ask me anything — I use recent chat when it helps

Quote-reply a summary or any reply in that thread to ask a follow-up. No mention needed for that.
Not opted in? Open a DM with me and send Yes or No.
